requirements.text: Staff request annual leave in the app by choosing a start date and an end date.
requirements.quote: Staff request annual leave in the app by choosing a start date and an end date.

requirements.text: Staff can carry over at most 5 unused annual leave days into the next year.
requirements.quote: Staff can carry over a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year.

requirements.text: Staff get an email when their line manager approves or declines their leave request.
